positions.name: CalibrationVerifiedAgainstReferencePlates
positions.frame: what standard grounds the claim that the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration holds?
positions.why: Both expressions anchor the calibration claim to the same external check — verification against the June reference plates — one in narrative form (src-1, adding that it holds across the full observing band) and one in summary labelled-field form (src-3). The directional read is the same: the calibration's validity rests on the reference-plate verification, not on assertion alone.
